question: What decision currently governs Python packaging governance? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-609 (Python Packaging Authority Governance) is the decision that currently governs Python Packaging Authority governance.
The authority evidence for PEP-609 is located at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0609.rst.
